qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/run_golden.sh, tests/polish.cjs (excerpts), results/polish.json (sha256 re-verified against the index)
evidence: Shared state across dimensions: all five judges run sequentially against one app process and one SQLite file (tests/test.sh:104-113 launch, :203-227 gates then scored with --max-concurrent-agent 1); every judge uses playwright-mcp --isolated, so browser storage does not carry over and the only cross-dimension state is the server library plus the single restart made by functional (functional/judge.toml:14-18, functional/prompt.md:29-31). The seed is empty (environment/assets/seed_data.json:2), so there is no seeded value any later criterion could quote. Mutations before later dimensions: the constraints gate saves one record and is told to 'Leave the saved record in place' (gates/constraints/judge.toml:32); functional saves roughly ten more and restarts the process. State-relative wording is present and injected into every dimension: app_context.md:23 'Saved records are identified by the server, not by title, and the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library and do not delete records that earlier checks created.'; app_context.md:22 'Use fresh scratch drafts'; app_context.md:27 fresh pages after the restart. I read all 3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria for absolute-state assumptions (empty library, a first record, a specific id, revision count of the library, an untouched app) and found none: persistence criteria create their own record with 'an exact unique title' and compare revisions relative to what they noted (functional/judge.toml:344, :353, :362, :371, :380, :389, :398); cw_preview_isolation compares the title and its own library entry 'as before' (:326); polish cw_undo_redo_availability accepts 'Load a saved snippet or start a new draft' (polish/judge.toml:50) and cw_unsaved_marker saves its own snippet (:59); visual makes its own ten-line draft (visual/prompt.md:12). 'same single record' / 'duplicated' in cw_save_reload_restart is keyed to the judge's own unique title, not to library size. No deletion is asked anywhere, so no later criterion can lose a record it relies on. Golden under accumulation: at desktop the library is a bounded scroll area (src/style.css '.library{max-height:36%}' with overflow:auto and a sticky heading), at <=520px the editor pane is height:auto so a long library is not clipped; server lists are unbounded and ordered (server.js:65). Measured: scripted polish and the 390px and 1440px screenshots ran last on the same app instance after the editor, runtime and persist suites had filled the library and after a real restart (run_golden.sh suite order editor runtime persist polish; results/polish.json all true incl. cw_narrow_width_usable; hashes match the index). Hosted configured-judge run on an EARLIER candidate: polish 1.0 and visual 0.9167 after functional, with the polish judge reusing a record left by functional ('Loaded saved snippet Isolation Canary ... Loaded #2') without trouble. Limits: no configured-judge run exists for these exact bytes, so run_verdict is PARTIAL; this row's verification is a wording check and does not depend on that run. Non-blocking latent observation (not graded, P3): between 521px and 850px the golden editor pane is a fixed 650px with overflow hidden while the library has max-height:none, so a long library could be clipped at tablet widths; criteria only use about 390px and about 1440px.
